independent_clause.definition: A clause containing a subject and finite verb expressing a complete proposition

dependent_adverbial_clause.definition: A clause introduced by a subordinating conjunction modifying the main predicate
dependent_adverbial_clause.example: Although the dataset was noisy, accuracy remained high.

dependent_relative_clause.definition: A postnominal clause modifying a noun phrase

restrictive.example: The model that won the benchmark used attention.

non_restrictive.example: The transformer, which was introduced in 2017, changed NLP.

dependent_noun_clause.definition: A clause functioning as a grammatical subject, direct object, or complement
dependent_noun_clause.example: We hypothesized that language models exhibit emergent behavior.
